verses.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ שִׁ֣ירוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ תְּ֝הִלָּתֹ֗ו בִּקְהַ֥ל חֲסִידִֽים׃
verses.ar: هَلِّلُويَا. غَنُّوا لِلرَّبِّ تَرْنِيمَةً جَدِيدَةً، تَسْبِيحَتَهُ فِي جَمَاعَةِ ٱلْأَتْقِيَاءِ.
verses.en: Hallelujah. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and His praise in the assembly of the saints.
verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, [and] his praise in the congregation of saints.
verses.web: Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

verses.he: יִשְׂמַ֣ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּעֹשָׂ֑יו בְּנֵֽי־צִ֝יֹּ֗ון יָגִ֥ילוּ בְמַלְכָּֽם׃
verses.ar: لِيَفْرَحْ إِسْرَائِيلُ بِخَالِقِهِ. لِيَبْتَهِجْ بَنُو صِهْيَوْنَ بِمَلِكِهِمْ.
verses.en: Let Israel rejoice in his Maker; let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.kjv: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.web: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

verses.he: יְהַֽלְל֣וּ שְׁמֹ֣ו בְמָחֹ֑ול בְּתֹ֥ף וְ֝כִנֹּ֗ור יְזַמְּרוּ־לֹֽו׃
verses.ar: لِيُسَبِّحُوا ٱسْمَهُ بِرَقْصٍ. بِدُفٍّ وَعُودٍ لِيُرَنِّمُوا لَهُ.
verses.en: Let them praise His name in the dance; let them sing praises unto Him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.kjv: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.web: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

verses.he: כִּֽי־רֹוצֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמֹּ֑ו יְפָאֵ֥ר עֲ֝נָוִ֗ים בִּישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ رَاضٍ عَنْ شَعْبِهِ. يُجَمِّلُ ٱلْوُدَعَاءَ بِٱلْخَلَاصِ.
verses.en: For the LORD taketh pleasure in His people; He adorneth the humble with salvation.
verses.kjv: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.web: For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

verses.ar: لِيَبْتَهِجِ ٱلْأَتْقِيَاءُ بِمَجْدٍ. لِيُرَنِّمُوا عَلَى مَضَاجِعِهِمْ.
verses.en: Let the saints exult in glory; let them sing for joy upon their beds.
verses.kjv: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
verses.web: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

verses.he: רֹומְמֹ֣ות אֵ֭ל בִּגְרֹונָ֑ם וְחֶ֖רֶב פִּֽיפִיֹּ֣ות בְּיָדָֽם׃
verses.ar: تَنْوِيهَاتُ ٱللهِ فِي أَفْوَاهِهِمْ، وَسَيْفٌ ذُو حَدَّيْنِ فِي يَدِهِمْ.
verses.en: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand;
verses.kjv: [Let] the high [praises] of God [be] in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;
verses.web: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

verses.ar: لِيَصْنَعُوا نَقْمَةً فِي ٱلْأُمَمِ، وَتَأْدِيبَاتٍ فِي ٱلشُّعُوبِ.
verses.en: To execute vengeance upon the nations, and chastisements upon the peoples;
verses.kjv: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, [and] punishments upon the people;
verses.web: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

verses.he: לֶאְסֹ֣ר מַלְכֵיהֶ֣ם בְּזִקִּ֑ים וְ֝נִכְבְּדֵיהֶ֗ם בְּכַבְלֵ֥י בַרְזֶֽל׃
verses.ar: لِأَسْرِ مُلُوكِهِمْ بِقُيُودٍ، وَشُرَفَائِهِمْ بِكُبُولٍ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ.
verses.en: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.kjv: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.web: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

verses.he: לַעֲשֹׂ֤ות בָּהֶ֨ם ׀ מִשְׁפָּ֬ט כָּת֗וּב הָדָ֣ר ה֭וּא לְכָל־חֲסִידָ֗יו הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
verses.ar: لِيُجْرُوا بِهِمْ ٱلْحُكْمَ ٱلْمَكْتُوبَ. كَرَامَةٌ هَذَا لِجَمِيعِ أَتْقِيَائِهِ. هَلِّلُويَا.
verses.en: To execute upon them the judgment written; He is the glory of all His saints. Hallelujah.
verses.kjv: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.web: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise Yah!
